title: Mechanical Design Basics: From Requirement to Release - open course files
description:
Open learner files of the free YouTube course Mechanical Design Basics: From Requirement to Release (24 episodes in three parts: Part 1 Define & Make It Strong, Ep 00-08; Part 2 Drawings, Tolerances & GD&T, Ep 09-16; Part 3 Make It Buildable & Release It, Ep 17-23). The course follows a fictional belt-driven actuator (ACT-100) and its sheet-metal motor bracket (ACT-103) from requirement to release; learners practise each step on their own shelf bracket.

Contents: a worksheet and an answer key for every episode (PDF); reference cards; engineering drawings and planted-error drawing exercises (PDF); a DXF flat pattern; spreadsheet templates and calculators (XLSX, CSV; Excel, LibreOffice or Google Sheets); STEP models of the ACT-103 bracket at Rev A and Rev B (FreeCAD opens them); and a Python generator (standard library only) that computes every number used in the course, with self-checks, plus a shelf-bracket exercise generator.

Fictional company, synthetic data. Standards are cited by number only; no standard text is reproduced and no endorsement is implied. Educational material - not for production, manufacture or legal use; verify with current standards and your supplier. Content CC BY 4.0; source code (*.py) MIT.
